senses.gloss: connection, whatever is in a connected state.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 18:9">Kel. XVIII, 9</cite> <he>המטה מיטמאת ח׳ וכ׳</he> a couch gets unclean only when combined, and can become clean again &c., opp. <he>איברים</he>; <cite ref="Sukkah 16a:1">Succ. 16ᵃ</cite>
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 10:3:3">Y. Ter. X, 47ᵇ</cite> top, v. <cite ref="G00416"><he>זֵיר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 72b:17">B. Mets. 72ᵇ</cite> <he>המוליך ח׳ וכ׳</he> if one carries a load (as a messenger) from one place to another (where prices are higher).
<cite ref="Kiddushin 65b:3">Kidd. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>וח׳ עמהם</he> and have luggage with them.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 78a:6">B. Mets. 78ᵃ</cite> <he>כשבאת ח׳ לידו</he> when the working man has left a bundle (of tools) with him (as a pledge that he will come to work); a. fr.—Pl. <he>חֲבִילוֹת</he>, <he>חֲבִילִין</he>, constr. (mostly) <he>חֲבִילֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 18:2">Sabb. XVIII, 2</cite> <he>ח׳ קש וכ׳</he> bundles of straw &c.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 7:1:4">Y. Ber. VII, beg. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>מג׳ ח׳</he> from three different bundles (of hyssop).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 10a:20">B. Kam. 10ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>מרבה בח׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. sing.) one adding bundles (of dry twigs) to the fire.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 49a:14">Ber. 49ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>אין עושין מצות ח׳ ח׳</he> we must not perform religious duties bundle-wise (but pay attention to each singly).

<cite ref="Eruvin 54b:21">Erub. 54ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 13:11">Prov. XIII, 11</cite>) <he>אם עושה … ח׳ ח׳ מתמעטת</he> Ms. O. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) if one studies bundle-wise (too many subjects at a time), his learning will decrease (ed. <he>מתמעט</he> he will become poorer in learning).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 84b:4">B. Mets. 84ᵇ</cite> <he>הקפתנו ח׳ תשובות וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) thou hast surrounded us with bundles of arguments which contain no substance; a. fr.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 10b:3">Ab. Zar. 10ᵇ</cite>, sq. <he>נתפרדה ח׳</he> the bond (of friendship between the two nations) is severed.—Pl. <he>חֲבִילִין</he>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 14:9">Lev. R. s. 14</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 905:5">Yalk. Job 905</cite> <he>עשוייה … ח׳ ח׳</he> consists of cells, convolutions and bands (muscles).
